solution.approach: Official Answer: Option C (**98.8**).
solution.keyConcept: Decimal LCM Rule: Equalize Decimal Digits (×100) -> Solve Integer LCM -> ÷100

trapAlert.en: Do NOT compute LCM(13, 76, 13) = 988 and divide by 10 thinking "1.3 has 1 decimal"! Equalize BOTH `1.30` and `7.60` to 2 decimal places FIRST.
trapAlert.hi: `1.30` व `7.60` में भी दो अंक बराबर करें! गलत `×10` करने से उत्तर 10 गुना बड़ा आ जाएगा।

title.hi: विधि 1: दशमलव बराबर कर पूर्णांक विधि

steps.en:
1) Write with equal 2 decimals: `1.30, 7.60, 0.13`.
2) Multiply by `100` ⇒ integers `130, 760, 13`.
3) Factorize: $130 = 13 \times 10$, $760 = 76 \times 10 = 19 \times 4 \times 10$, $13 = 13$.
4) $\text{LCM}(130, 760, 13) = 13 \times 76 \times 10 = 9880$.
5) Divide by `100` ⇒ $9880 / 100 = \mathbf{98.8}$.

title.en: Method 2: Smart `13 × 7.6` Direct Scaling + Multiple Check

steps.en: `1.3` = $10 \times 0.13$ (absorbs `0.13` completely). Notice `1.3` and `7.6` share only `0.1` (`13` & `76` are co-prime): $\text{LCM} = 1.3 \times 76 = \mathbf{98.8}$ (`3 × 6 ends in .8` -> ONLY Option C has `.8`!).

solution.en:
Method 1: Equalize Decimal Places (`×100`): 1) Write with equal 2 decimals: `1.30, 7.60, 0.13`.
2) Multiply by `100` ⇒ integers `130, 760, 13`.
3) Factorize: $130 = 13 \times 10$, $760 = 76 \times 10 = 19 \times 4 \times 10$, $13 = 13$.
4) $\text{LCM}(130, 760, 13) = 13 \times 76 \times 10 = 9880$.
5) Divide by `100` ⇒ $9880 / 100 = \mathbf{98.8}$.

Method 2: Smart `13 × 7.6` Direct Scaling + Multiple Check: `1.3` = $10 \times 0.13$ (absorbs `0.13` completely). Notice `1.3` and `7.6` share only `0.1` (`13` & `76` are co-prime): $\text{LCM} = 1.3 \times 76 = \mathbf{98.8}$ (`3 × 6 ends in .8` -> ONLY Option C has `.8`!).
